title: Tiebele House Painting
tagline: Finish the wall pattern in earth pigments, then save it from the rain.
description: A symmetry puzzle inspired by the painted walls of Tiebele in Burkina Faso. Complete the elder's pattern as a mirror, turn or repeat with limited earth pigments, glaze the cells before the rain, and repair the wall. 18 walls, a Daily Wall, Think and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Pick a pigment pot, then drag across cells to paint them.
Paint the empty half as the symmetric copy of the elder's half.
Pigment is limited: fewer, longer strokes score best.
When the rain comes, tap each ring before the drop lands.
Repaint what was washed, then tap Done to have the wall checked.
